preconditions.description: Attacker must have the BURNER_ROLE to call the burn function
Victim address must hold some amount of the token

exploit_hint: As an attacker with BURNER_ROLE, call the burn() function targeting a victim address that holds tokens. This will destroy the victim's tokens, reducing total supply and potentially increasing the value of remaining tokens (including attacker's holdings). The attack demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can arbitrarily burn tokens from any address.
